convertibility_reason: Uses external .mqh library (Base/BaseFrame.mqh) for core trading framework including MA handling, state management, and order execution. Entry/exit logic depends on framework methods (MA_Direction, ResetState, Processing) not visible in this file. Custom class hierarchy with virtual method overrides.

derived_values.name: MA direction from MAS6 shifted subset (indices 3-5)
derived_values.formula: MA_Direction(mas[3 sub-arrays from MAS6[3..5] with first element removed], period=6, shift=0)

derived_values.name: MA direction for exit from MAS6

other_exits: Auto close after Auto_Close_After_X_H1 hours (default 4H1 bars)
Exit when MA_Direction(MAS6, period=2, shift=1) direction differs from entry direction and minimum bar count reached (state.will_close_bars)

position_sizing.conditional_logic: Add-position when floating profit > state.lots * 500, add size = Trade_Init_Lots

custom_logic_notes: 1. Core trading framework (EABaseFrame) is entirely in external library Base/BaseFrame.mqh - Init/Processing/ResetState/MA_Direction/state management are all opaque. 2. Entry signals (LongOpen/ShortOpen) are currently commented out - EA as written will NOT open new positions. 3. IsMAEverFit uses MAS6[3..5] sub-arrays, strips first element, then checks MA_Direction across 2 iterations with progressive element deletion. 4. Time filter supports two separate time windows: US-session pairs (USTime) and non-US-session pairs (NUSTime) with fractional hour support. 5. IsInDealTime has a bug on line 145: min < us_right_hour should likely be min < us_right_minute. 6. CheckAddLong/CheckAddShort use profit threshold of lots*500 (likely point-based profit check). 7. Exit logic checks iBars >= state.will_close_bars (minimum holding period) AND MA direction reversal. 8. Deal_Direction_Allow enum (DIPP_RectION_DEAL with BOTH/UP/DOWN) gates long/short entry. 9. Magic number hardcoded as 50000.
python_conversion_notes: 1. BaseFrame.mqh must be fully reverse-engineered before conversion - it contains MA_Direction, state struct, Processing loop, order management, and all indicator setup. 2. MAS6 is an array of CArrayDouble arrays populated by the framework - the exact MA calculations and periods are unknown without the library. 3. The state object (state.profit, state.lots, state.direction, state.will_close_bars, state.addlots, state.dealprice, state.takeprofit_mode, state.stoploss_mode) must be reconstructed from the library. 4. IsInDealTime time filter logic has a likely bug (us_right_hour vs us_right_minute) - decide whether to replicate bug or fix. 5. Entry signals are currently disabled (commented out) - conversion would produce an EA that only manages existing positions. 6. The CArrayDouble operations (AssignArray, DeleteRange, Delete) need Python list equivalents. 7. lot_amplifier scaling logic is in the framework. 8. Auto_Close_After_X_H1 uses H1 bar counting not actual elapsed time.
